content.bridge_context: Quantifying how objects move and how we track time.

units.title: What is Motion?
units.explanation: Change in position of an object with time. Types: Uniform and Non-uniform.
units.dual_language_instruction: Give an example of periodic motion. / आवर्ती गति (periodic motion) का एक उदाहरण दें।

units.title: Measuring Time
units.explanation: Ancient tools (Sundial, Water clock) vs Modern tools (Pendulum clock, Quartz watch).
units.dual_language_instruction: What is the SI unit of time? / समय की SI इकाई क्या है?
